newsitem.title: USA: Spartech buys Hamelin's extrusion assets.
newsitem.headline: Spartech buys Hamelin's extrusion assets.

text.p: Spartech Corp said Friday it completed the purchase of Hamelin Group Inc's extrusion, color and molding divisions for about $57.7 million in cash and assumption of certain liabilities.
The acquired assets are in Montreal.
President Bradley Buechler said the purchase expands the company's share of the $1.1 billion North American custom extruded sheet and rollstock market to about 34 percent.

"Spartech now has total annual production capacity of approximately 600 million pounds in its three operating divisions -- extruded sheet and rollstock (400 million), merchant compounding (150 million) and molded products (50 million), with annualized sales of nearly $500 million," Buechler said in a statement.

The company plans to add equipment to enhance production facilities into the newly acquired operations, to reduce each unit's current idle capacity, which is now about 15 to 20 percent. Following the modifications, Buechler said the new businesses "should be capable of producing operating income of 10 to 15 percent annually."
